name: Stabl
tagline: Enterprise infrastructure for animal records, compliance, and care operations.
positioning: Stabl is the system of record for organizations managing animal populations at scale — vaccination, custody, insurance, and audit in one governed platform.

hero.h1: The system of record for animals under management.
hero.sub: Stabl consolidates vaccination logs, custody chains, insurance claims, and veterinary audits into one governed platform — built for organizations accountable for thousands of animals.

features.title: Unified custody ledger
features.description: Track every transfer, adoption, and facility move with a tamper-evident chain of custody. Reconstruct any animal's full history for regulators in seconds, not weeks.

features.title: Vaccination compliance engine
features.description: Enforce jurisdiction-specific vaccination schedules across facilities. Automatic flags before a lapse becomes a liability or a failed inspection.

features.title: Audit-ready reporting
features.description: Generate USDA, state, and insurer-formatted exports from live data. Every figure links back to its source event and the operator who logged it.

features.title: Facility federation
features.description: Roll up shelters, clinics, and holding sites under one governance layer with per-site access controls and centralized policy enforcement.

features.title: Claims integration
features.description: Push structured medical and custody records directly to insurance partners via API, cutting claim disputes and settlement times.

features.title: Role-based access
features.description: Scoped permissions for veterinarians, intake staff, and compliance officers, with full activity logs on every record touched.

testimonials.quote: Before Stabl our vaccination records lived in four spreadsheets and a filing cabinet. Our last state inspection took ninety minutes instead of three days.
testimonials.name: Marisol Reyes

testimonials.quote: The custody ledger settled a transfer dispute across two counties that would have taken our legal team a month. We pulled the full chain in one export.
testimonials.name: Daniel Okafor

testimonials.quote: We metered by processed records, so onboarding twelve new clinics didn't blow up a fixed license. The billing scaled exactly with our caseload.
testimonials.name: Priya Nair

For multi-facility operators needing federation and claims.
For national networks and insurers with governance mandates.

homepage.footerBlurb: Stabl is the governed system of record for organizations accountable for animals at scale. Built for compliance officers, not clipboards.
